sceneDescription: On a supermarket bakery shelf, a glistening gold bar is nestled in the middle of a row of everyday sandwich bread loaves. The gold bar’s shiny surface contrasts absurdly against the soft, flour-dusted bread. A Modern Retail-branded shopping bag peeks from the side, a small PYMNTS sticker is stuck to a bread wrapper, and an Instore Magazine logo is subtly stamped on a twist tie. Natural morning light illuminates the shelf, making the gold bar look strangely at home yet completely out of place.
finalImagePrompt: A supermarket bakery shelf with ordinary loaves of sandwich bread in a neat row. In the middle, a solid gold bar sits among the bread, gleaming. A Modern Retail shopping bag is tucked at one end of the shelf, a small PYMNTS sticker is on a bread wrapper, and an Instore Magazine logo appears on a bread twist tie. The lighting is bright and natural.
